ValidationRule.description: When a user once checks 'Outcome Letter to be sent by Mail' checkbox it cannot be unchecked again.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), PRIORVALUE(Outcome_Letter_to_be_sent_by_Mail__c)== true, ISCHANGED(Outcome_Letter_to_be_sent_by_Mail__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once check box "Outcome Letter to be sent by Mail" has been selected, it cannot be unchecked
